ratings_why.fun: Early free hits, a growing Announced carry from Tier 2 and a Gust storm that pays off late give a curve I'd happily draft, though Tier 4 adds little lasting growth.
ratings_why.distinct: Announced turns play order into a decision every turn and lets any tribe's unit be the carry; Gust itself is close to familiar extra-attack effects.

verdict_why: The engine and curve work; one real rules gap (whether a Gust counts as an attack) needs settling before it plays as written.

points.text: Say whether a Gust counts as an attack. The Föhn ruling says yes, but then Lady High Pressure's 'first 3 attacks don't happen' would cancel enemy Gusts and Gale cards that react to attacks fire on Gusts, and players can't tell which.

Old Föhn makes enemy units Gust; against another Gale player, say whether those count as their friendly Gusts for Mares' Tails, the Warden and Thunder. As written the keyword's 'never counts enemy ones' doesn't settle it.

Tier 4 has no lasting growth, so the board stalls between Red Sky and the Warden. A Tier 4 card that turns Gusts into permanent stats on the Announced unit, smaller than the Warden, would smooth the curve.
The Warden with the Helm gives two Announced units +20/+20 a fight each, and golden or copied by Sir Vane doubles again. Keep it hot; it's the build's chase, just give the owner a number to watch.
The Barometer Clerk's gold arrives only once the storm is already running, when gold matters least. Paying on 2 Gusts, or growing the Announced unit instead of itself, would give it a job.

standouts.why: Duke Cumulonimbus is a real capstone: the board is arranged to feed him Thunder and keep the Crier's forecast from firing him early.
The Helm turns the Announced tension into a second carry and doubles every Announced payoff, a proper Tier 4 multiplier.
Red Sky at Night starts the Announced carry at Tier 2 and makes 'what do I play last' matter from the first shops.

weakest.why: Mr and Mrs Fair-and-Foul give half a gold a turn and a Gust every other fight; neither half does enough.
The Barometer Clerk pays gold late and otherwise grows only itself.
The Bag-Bearer is a 4/4 with a small item; fine glue, little Tier 4 output.

flags.note: Warden plus Helm is about 80 permanent stats a fight, 160 golden, more with Sir Vane copying it; capped per fight but steep.
Shutting off all enemy Start of Combat effects hard-counters whole builds, other Gale players included.
Sir Vane copying a Tier 6 capstone at Tier 5, and golden Vane copying two, is the highest roll in the tribe.
With the Wild Hunt, every Gust is a free hit; with the Duke's 10 Gusts and the Crier, the enemy front row can vanish before a normal attack.
Whether the enemy's Gusts count among 'the first 3 attacks' is not said.
